title: 'Forgotten Island' song gets 2 nominations at Hollywood Music in Media Awards
summary: A song from 'Forgotten Island,' an animated fantasy film that draws heavily from Philippine mythology, has received two nominations at the Hollywood Music in Media Awards (HMMAs).
